content: {"question":"What should a new manager do in the first few weeks to establish credibility with their former peers?","answer":"They should meet with the team both as a group and individually, sharing their management style and reviewing the Manager README.","evidence":"Also, in the first few weeks, take actions that establish your credibility and indicate how you'll work as a manager. One of the best ways is to meet with your team, as a group and individually, and share with them your management style or review your Manager [README](/handbook/leadership/#your-individual-readme)."}
